name: Aquatic Form
label: Quest
description: You return to Darnassus with the restored Pendant of the Sea Lion. The rite teaches Alliance druids to attune their spirits to deep waters.

clips.title: The story
paras: You return to Darnassus with the restored Pendant of the Sea Lion. The rite teaches Alliance druids to attune their spirits to deep waters.

For Cenarion Circle initiates, shapeshifting joins the druid’s spirit to the wild aspects of Azeroth. After enduring trials in the dark coastal depths and in Moonglade, young night elf druids receive the assembled Pendant of the Sea Lion from Dendrite Starblaze. They carry the sacred token back to Teldrassil as proof of their respect for the laws of air, water, and breath.

Mathrengyl Bearwalker awaits your return in the Cenarion Enclave. The trials along the coasts of Darkshore and Westfall demand endurance and attunement. Presenting the completed pendant shows Bearwalker that your mind and body are ready to shed their mortal skin and take the swift, breathing form of the sea lion.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have completed the necessary lessons all young druids are taught before they can adopt an aquatic aspect. Go now back to your trainer, Mathrengyl Bearwalker, in Darnassus. Show him your pendant and prove to him you are ready to learn what he has to teach you. He will complete your training, allowing you to become one with the water.
Goodbye, young druid. We shall speak again.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Your return to Darnassus is not without heralding, though I will need proof of your lessons learned in Moonglade before I will teach you your aquatic form.
Do you have the Pendant of the Sea Lion?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Very impressive, friend. You are ready to learn your aquatic form, and it is my pleasure to teach it to you.
Also, in recognition of your achievement during the two trials, I give you this item. I hope you'll find it to be a welcome addition to your gear as a protector of nature and a keeper of the balance.
